decisions.reason: This industrial AC input module remains a core automation building block with a dedicated product-page presence, so it is very likely to stay in the range.
The solid state relay module fits the firm's modular control portfolio well and is inexpensive to maintain as part of the established system offer.
The RGB LED control module is less central than sensing and industrial I/O products, but it still complements the platform for signaling, prototyping and automation applications.
The remote access service for wallboxes supports the firm's stated expansion in charging and energy-management products, making continued investment and retention likely.
